title: Display a Simple Message
description: Store `"VidyaQuest"` in a variable named `platform` and print `Learning on VidyaQuest is fun!`.
instructions: Create a string variable named `platform` with value `"VidyaQuest"`.
Print `Learning on VidyaQuest is fun!` using that variable.
constraints: Output must be exactly: Learning on VidyaQuest is fun!
hints: In Python: platform = "VidyaQuest", then print(f"Learning on {platform} is fun!").
In JS: const platform = "VidyaQuest"; console.log(`Learning on ${platform} is fun!`);
In Java: String platform = "VidyaQuest"; System.out.println("Learning on " + platform + " is fun!");

starterCode.python:
platform = "VidyaQuest"
# Print the message using platform
starterCode.javascript:
const platform = "VidyaQuest";
// Print the message using platform
